name: pigfarmmix-helper
description: 猪猪图鉴 — 收藏收集与配种查询工具

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:copy && npm run build:web && npm run build:sw
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.sw.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.functions.json && tsc -p workers/push-cron/tsconfig.json
scripts.deploy:db: wrangler d1 execute pigfarmmix-helper-prod --file=functions/db/schema.sql --remote && wrangler d1 execute pigfarmmix-helper-prod --file=functions/db/seed.sql --remote
scripts.dev: npm run build && npx wrangler pages dev dist
